title: BBC Philip Marlowe
paragraphs: BBC Radio dramatizations of Raymond Chandler's Philip Marlowe novels, with Ed Bishop portraying the hard-boiled Los Angeles private detective in the original BBC adaptation cycle.

BBC Radio 4 Classic Chandler season adapting all seven completed Philip Marlowe novels plus posthumous Poodle Springs, starring Toby Stephens. Frozen eight-object set exactly matches the 2011 cycle; embedded metadata on all eight files says 2011.

GRH documents the program through Classic Chandler winter block (February 5, 2011 to February 26, 2011) on [[org|org.deepv2.507b7f3aadcb7123|BBC Radio 4]] and Classic Chandler autumn block (October 1, 2011 to October 22, 2011) on [[org|org.deepv2.507b7f3aadcb7123|BBC Radio 4]].

Among the most extensively documented contributors in the GRH holdings are Toby Stephens (performer on 8 recordings), Claire Grove (director on 4 recordings and producer on 3 recordings), Robin Brooks (radio adaptor on 4 recordings), Stephen Wyatt (radio adaptor on 4 recordings), Mary Peate (director on 1 recording), and Sasha Yevtushenko (director on 1 recording).
Its indexed subjects and listening characteristics include hardboiled detective fiction, Los Angeles crime and corruption, Philip Marlowe, Raymond Chandler adaptation, and BBC Radio 4 drama.

GRH also places the series in documented historical contexts including BBC Radio 4 Classic Chandler complete cycle, Posthumous completion of Poodle Springs, and First BBC all-novel Marlowe cycle including Playback and Poodle Springs.
